title: Green Dragon in Polluted Swamp
description: A vibrant green dragon with large blue eyes and a red-and-yellow striped scarf stands in a polluted, swampy landscape filled with car wrecks, tires, and debris. Above, a floating, leafy green face resembling a nature spirit disperses particles into the cloudy sky.
prompt: A vibrant green dragon with large blue eyes, sharp teeth, and a red-and-yellow striped scarf stands in a polluted, swampy landscape filled with car wrecks, tires, and debris under a blue sky with orange clouds. Above the dragon, a floating leafy green face resembling a nature spirit with closed eyes disperses green particles downward, in a detailed whimsical fantasy style with rich textures and vibrant colors.
